data.name: NINJA CATS: Tactics
data.detailed_description:
Build the Ultimate Ninja Squad with Your Voice!

NINJA CATS: Tactics is a battle RPG where you train, command, and fight alongside adorable ninja cats. Form contracts with 16 unique ninja cats, each with their own fighting style, personality, and skills. Communicate with them and strategize in battles to claim victory in the world of ninja cat combat!

Gameplay

  • Turn-Based Tactical Battles: Lead your ninja cat team in strategic battles set in castles. Use their unique skills and take advantage of terrain features like height differences and obstacles to position your troops effectively. Master formations and outmaneuver your enemies!

  • Hako-Niwa (Miniature World): Your ninja cats live in a customizable space where you can talk to them freely. These conversations influence their skill growth and teamwork. Arrange items to create the ideal training environment and strengthen your squad.

  • Story Mode: Fight your way through the original story as the hero and rise to the top of the Ninja Cat battles.

Features

  • Tiny and Adorable Ninja Cats: Meet and recruit 16 different ninja cats, each with unique fighting styles, personalities, and skills. Even cats that look the same may have completely different personalities, so choose your team wisely!

  • Voice Interaction: Talk to your ninja cats to enhance their skills and abilities! The right words can power them up instantly, but be careful—not all words will be received well. Can you motivate them effectively during training?

  • Turn-Based RPG Battles: Form a team with your trained ninja cats and engage in 5v5 battles! Eliminate enemy teams or capture their base to claim victory.

Story

In this world, there exists a special kind of creature known as Ninja Cats.
These ninja cats, found all over Japan, are incredibly cute—but don’t be fooled by their appearance.

Ninja cats are more than just adorable; they possess special powers (skills) and have assisted people in various ways throughout history.

Now, ninja cats have become an indispensable part of life, and among them, Ninja Cat Battles have captivated the world as one of the most exciting forms of entertainment.

Collect, train, and battle with a variety of ninja cats—
Step into the world of Ninja Cat Battles today!

data.short_description: Build the ultimate ninja squad with your voice! NINJA CATS: Tactics is a battle RPG where communicating with your ninja cats builds trust. Train and nurture them through voice commands, shaping their skills and abilities. Enjoy chatting with them or streaming your adventure—it's up to you!

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or higher / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 or higher / AMD Radeon RX 590 or higher / Intel Arc A750, VRAM 4GB or more
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 48,000Hz, 16-bit, stereo
